description: This file implements the WebBridge plugin for the WPEFramework, including initialization, message handling, WebSocket communication, and registration of JSON-RPC methods.

classes.name: Registration
classes.description: A JSON container class for registration information, including event and callsign.

methods.name: WebBridge::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebBridge plugin with the provided service, setting configuration and state.

methods.name: WebBridge::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: WebBridge::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel if it uses the JSON protocol and is not already attached.

methods.name: WebBridge::Invoke
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON-RPC messages, routing registration, unregistration, and forwarding custom requests.

methods.name: WebBridge::Activate
methods.description: Activation logic, currently empty as initialization is done earlier.

methods.name: WebBridge::Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivation logic, currently empty as cleanup is handled elsewhere.

methods.name: WebBridge::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages, creating new JSONRPC messages or routing responses.
